clarity.justification: The proposal gives directional, decidable predictions, including “internal-ripple magnitude = probe belief(BASE-present) minus probe belief(BASE-absent),” a selectivity gap “>= 0.2 probability,” and predictive AUROC “>= 0.70 and >= 0.05 above log-prob,” with explicit negative outcomes for each; these thresholds make the hypotheses strongly falsifiable. However, the central read-time construct is underspecified: the probe is applied “at the entailed-item tokens” while the belief is supposedly read “WITHOUT ever asking the entailed question,” but the plan never explains how an unmentioned entailed proposition—potentially containing entities absent from the base fact—is represented by tokens without presenting a statement or other readout that could itself trigger inference. Thus the experiments and metrics are otherwise well aligned, but an expert must resolve a foundational ambiguity about the activation location and whether it genuinely measures propagation before elicitation.

feasibility.justification: The hardest step is operationalizing “the entailed-item tokens” and extracting a proposition-specific state before any entailed prompt; this is not impossible, but as written it is a custom, insufficiently defined measurement rather than a standard forward-hook operation. The named models and methods—“Llama-3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B, Pythia-2.8B,” logistic probes, activation patching, CAA-style activation addition, bootstrap confidence intervals, and AUROC analysis—exist and are supported by standard ML and interpretability tooling, while the proposed synthetic benchmark is constructible from the enumerated relation rules. Resources are unusually well quantified (“5,000 synthetic” graphs, “~1,000” real items, “70/15/15,” “5 seeds,” and steering at “2/4/8% residual norm”), and the BASE-absent, shuffled-label, matched non-entailment, random-direction, lexical, log-probability, and hidden-state-norm controls make negative results runnable; resolving the activation-target ambiguity is the principal methodological roadblock.
